What a draw call carries to the render bridge: the matrices and the pixel grid, the render state with its blending and stencil, the vertices, and the JOID GLSL sources with their translation and uniforms.
Learn: [Render pipeline](/build/pipeline/), [Shader translation](/build/shader-translation/), [Drawing resources and transforms](/use/learn/going-further/drawing-resources-and-transforms/).

## Main types

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`BlendState`](/reference/pipeline/blendstate/) | class | How a draw combines its colors with the pixels already on the target, an equation and four factors. |
| [`CoreShader`](/reference/pipeline/coreshader/) | enum | The JOID GLSL shaders of the core, which draw text, shapes, lines and the built-in effects on every backend. |
| [`DepthRange`](/reference/pipeline/depthrange/) | class | Converts a projection from the OpenGL depth range, -1 to 1, to a clip space whose depth goes from 0 to 1. |
| [`GlslDialect`](/reference/pipeline/glsldialect/) | enum | A GLSL or GLSL ES version that the shader translator writes, with the language features that each version allows. |
| [`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/) | class | Rewrites the JOID GLSL stages of a shader into the dialect of a backend, with the declarations, uniforms and wrappers that JOID adds around the body. |
| [`ImplicitConversion`](/reference/pipeline/implicitconversion/) | class | Rewrites the integer literals of a GLSL body as float literals where a float is expected, for the dialects whose compiler does not convert them. |
| [`MatrixStack`](/reference/pipeline/matrixstack/) | class | A 4×4 transformation matrix with a stack that saves and restores it, as the model-view and the projection of the render bridge. |
| [`PipelineKey`](/reference/pipeline/pipelinekey/) | class | The part of the render state that a pipeline object bakes in, as a value that a backend uses as the key of its pipeline cache. |
| [`PixelGrid`](/reference/pipeline/pixelgrid/) | class | Maps design pixels onto the screen pixels of the current projection, model-view and viewport, and snaps edges, sizes and motions onto whole pixels. |
| [`Primitive`](/reference/pipeline/primitive/) | enum | How the vertices of a draw join, in segments or in triangles. |
| [`RenderState`](/reference/pipeline/renderstate/) | class | The settings that every draw reads, color, blending, texture, shader, lines, depth, stencil, viewport and target. |
| [`ShaderBuiltin`](/reference/pipeline/shaderbuiltin/) | enum | The names that a JOID GLSL source uses without declaring them, the vertex attributes, the matrices and the lighting that JOID provides, and the fragment output. |
| [`ShaderFeature`](/reference/pipeline/shaderfeature/) | enum | A GLSL feature that only some dialects accept, with the first desktop and ES versions that have it and the pattern that finds it in a source. |
| [`ShaderSource`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/) | class | One stage of a shader written in JOID GLSL, parsed so that every backend can translate it. |
| [`ShaderStage`](/reference/pipeline/shaderstage/) | enum | The two programmable stages of a JOID shader. |
| [`ShaderTranslation`](/reference/pipeline/shadertranslation/) | class | The translated sources of a shader, ready for the graphics API, the vertex and fragment stages and the optional stencil write stage. |
| [`ShaderVariable`](/reference/pipeline/shadervariable/) | class | A variable that a shader source declares, an input, an output, a uniform or a sampler, as the translator reads and writes it again. |
| [`StencilEmulation`](/reference/pipeline/stencilemulation/) | class | Stencil test and update done in the fragment shader, for a backend whose targets have no stencil buffer. |
| [`StencilFunction`](/reference/pipeline/stencilfunction/) | enum | The comparison of a stencil test between the masked reference and the masked stored value. |
| [`StencilOperation`](/reference/pipeline/stenciloperation/) | enum | What a draw does to the stored stencil value after the stencil and depth tests. |
| [`StencilState`](/reference/pipeline/stencilstate/) | class | The immutable stencil settings of the render state, comparison, reference, mask and the three operations. |
| [`UniformBlock`](/reference/pipeline/uniformblock/) | class | Holds every uniform value of a shader at its std140 offset, tracks which ones changed, and packs or hands them to the backend before a draw. |
| [`UniformLayout`](/reference/pipeline/uniformlayout/) | enum | How a translated program declares its uniforms, in one std140 block or one by one. |
| [`UniformMember`](/reference/pipeline/uniformmember/) | class | One uniform of a block, its std140 place, its current value as raw 32-bit words, and whether it changed since the backend last sent it. |
| [`UniformSampler`](/reference/pipeline/uniformsampler/) | class | One sampler of a shader, its texture unit and the texture, filter and wrap bound to it. |
| [`UniformType`](/reference/pipeline/uniformtype/) | enum | The GLSL types that a uniform can have, with the component and column counts that set its std140 size and the values that it accepts. |
| [`VertexAttribute`](/reference/pipeline/vertexattribute/) | enum | The attributes of a JOID vertex, each with its shader input, its location, its byte offset and its format. |
| [`VertexBuffer`](/reference/pipeline/vertexbuffer/) | class | The vertices of one draw, in the fixed 32-byte layout that every backend reads. |
| [`VertexComponent`](/reference/pipeline/vertexcomponent/) | enum | The numeric type of the components of a vertex attribute. |
| [`VertexFill`](/reference/pipeline/vertexfill/) | class | Copies a vertex buffer into memory of the backend and writes neutral values where the draw left optional attributes out. |

## Supporting types

Nested types and listeners that the main types use.

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`BlendState.Equation`](/reference/pipeline/blendstate-equation/) | enum | The operation that combines the weighted source and destination colors of a blend state. |
| [`BlendState.Factor`](/reference/pipeline/blendstate-factor/) | enum | A weight that a blend state applies to the source or the destination color before its equation. |
| [`PixelGrid.Span`](/reference/pipeline/pixelgrid-span/) | class | The snapped edges of a shape along one axis, with the coverage that fades a span thinner than a pixel. |
| [`ShaderBuiltin.Kind`](/reference/pipeline/shaderbuiltin-kind/) | enum | How the translator declares a built-in name, as a vertex attribute, a uniform or the fragment output. |
| [`StencilEmulation.Pass`](/reference/pipeline/stencilemulation-pass/) | enum | Which stencil code a translated fragment stage carries. |
